## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (a bug fix starts with a test that fails without it)
- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `gofmt` are clean
- [ ] Docs updated and a line added under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md` for anything users can notice
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real account data or personal paths
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are permissively licensed (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC) and justified above
